info.name: Elevon POS - FBR Digital Invoicing sandbox
info.description: Payloads for PRAL DI API v1.12 exactly as Elevon POS will build them (spec section 7). Set token and the seller/buyer fields in a Postman ENVIRONMENT, never in this file. Order: 1 Reference lists, 2 Validate, 3 Post, 4 Negative. Sandbox only: every URL here ends in _sb or is a read-only reference list.

exec: // Business date and reference-list date, pinned to Asia/Karachi.
const parts = now.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Asia/Karachi', day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }).split(' ');
console.warn('No token set: create a Postman environment with token = your IRIS sandbox bearer token.');

variable.description: Override in an environment. IRIS sandbox bearer token.
Seller NTN (7 digits) or CNIC (13 digits), digits only
PCT 2711.1910 L.P.G.; advisor to confirm before enabling
Must equal a ratE_DESC from SaleTypeToRate
Goods at standard rate (default) = 75 per /pdi/v1/transtypecode (18 is Services). Confirmed 2026-09-21
Mandatory top-level reason on a Debit Note (error 0027 without it)

request.description: Only Sale Invoice (4) and Debit Note (9) exist; there is no Credit Note.
Goods at standard rate (default) is id 75; id 18 is Services.
rate_desc must equal one of the returned ratE_DESC values (expect 18%).
KG must appear here or FBR answers 0099/0165 on every invoice. The app will refuse to enable fiscal if it does not.

item.name: A. SN002 walk-in, one kg line

request.description: Unregistered walk-in buyer. 12.500 kg x Rs 265.00 = 3,312.50; 18 % = 596.25; totalValues 3,908.75. The app rounds the receipt to Rs 3,909 but the rounding adjustment is NOT sent (spec 7.4).

exec: try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { pm.test('response is JSON', () => { throw new Error(pm.response.text()); }); }
(vr.invoiceStatuses || []).forEach((s, i) => console.log('line', i + 1, s.statusCode, s.errorCode || '', s.error || ''));

item.name: B. SN001 registered buyer, tonne line

request.description: Registered buyer (set buyer_ntn etc. in the environment). 1 tonne entered as 1000.000 kg x Rs 262.00 = 262,000.00; tax 47,160.00; totalValues 309,160.00.

exec: try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { pm.test('response is JSON', () => { throw new Error(pm.response.text()); }); }
(vr.invoiceStatuses || []).forEach((s, i) => console.log('line', i + 1, s.statusCode, s.errorCode || '', s.error || ''));

item.name: E. Debit Note (void) against last posted invoice, registered buyer

request.description: Sandbox facts (2026-09-21): Credit Note is rejected with 0003; the void document is a Debit Note with invoiceRefNo = the original FBR number and a mandatory top-level reason. A Debit Note also requires a REGISTERED buyer (0106 otherwise), so set buyer_ntn to a real sales-tax-registered NTN and post B first so last_invoice_number belongs to that buyer.
